info.description: API documentation for Twinspace microservices - Organization and File management.

parameters.description: Organization slug (first path segment). Supports nested paths (e.g., 'my-org', 'my-org/nested/path')

get.summary: Get dashboard data with all entities
get.description: Returns a comprehensive dashboard containing materials, assignments, nodes, equipment, and playlists. All entities use flat DTOs with ID references instead of nested objects for optimal dashboard rendering.

parameters.name: org
parameters.description: Optional: Organization slug or ID to filter all entities

parameters.name: userId
parameters.description: Optional: User ID to filter assignments (only assignments assigned to this user)

materials.description: Array of materials (flat DTOs with comment IDs)

assignments.description: Array of assignments (flat DTOs with content ID)

nodes.description: Array of nodes (flat DTOs with entity IDs)

equipment.description: Array of equipment (flat DTOs with material and playlist IDs)

playlists.description: Array of playlists (flat DTOs with material IDs)

filename.description: Original filename provided by the client
